metadata.description: A personal teacher for Claude Code — learns from your own sessions and teaches you back.

plugins.name: daily-lesson
plugins.description: Scan recent Claude Code sessions and teach you one thing you relied on but probably don't fully understand. Renders an interactive HTML lesson from a frozen canonical template — in your choice of lecture mode (tone + depth), and you can recast any lesson into another tone — with an optional per-lesson chat powered by your local claude CLI. Lessons are generated locally; chat answers come from your own claude CLI.
